response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate) / AVG(replacement_cost) AS ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, ratio, film_count, ratio - AVG(ratio) OVER () AS diff_from_avg_ratio FROM r

assumptions.assumption: 'Rental price' means film.rental_rate. The per-rating ratio is the ratio of group averages (AVG(rental_rate)/AVG(replacement_cost)), so each rating is one aggregate ratio. The film count is the number of films in the catalogue, not inventory copies. The overall average is the unweighted mean of the 5 rating-level ratios, as the request says.

alternatives.interpretation: The rating's ratio is the average of the per-film ratios rental_rate/replacement_cost, rather than the ratio of averages.
